decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (1201-00-01A & 1201-21-01A) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The service area, including the canopy to which this application relates shall not receive any delivery vehicles, nor dispatch vehicles between the hours of 11.00pm to 6.30am unless the service area is covered

Condition : 4 - The noise emitted from the relocated compactor unit shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The levels shall be determined according to BS4142:1997,

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey free standing canopy for the loading of delivery vehicles and associated relocation of the existing compactor unit.
